name: twoai-site
comment_supply_chain: Build integrity: the Cloudflare build command is `npm ci` (NOT `npm install`), so every deploy installs the exact tree in package-lock.json rather than floating ^ ranges to whatever published since the last build. A poisoned patch release cannot enter a build without a lockfile change in a reviewed commit. The prebuild `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` fails the build on a known high/critical advisory in the shipped dependency tree. Keep the lockfile committed and let Dependabot open the version-bump PRs.
